description: This is a build and test script for running Rialto unit tests, including setup for environment variables, test suite management, build automation, and optional code coverage and valgrind analysis.

methods.name: runcmd
methods.description: Executes a subprocess command, exits on error unless error code is valgrindErrorCode.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function to parse arguments and orchestrate build and test execution.

methods.name: strOfKeys
methods.description: Converts a dictionary of suite info into a comma-separated string of keys.

methods.name: getSuitesToRun
methods.description: Determines which test suites to run based on user input, defaults to all.

methods.name: buildTargets
methods.description: Configures and builds test targets using CMake and Make.

methods.name: runTests
methods.description: Runs specified test suites, optionally with valgrind and coverage, and handles test result processing.

methods.name: AddValgrind
methods.description: Constructs valgrind command arguments for a test suite, with options for output redirection.

methods.name: generateCoverageReport
methods.description: Generates code coverage reports using lcov and genhtml.
